title: An R-loop-related gene signature predicts prognosis and shapes the immune microenvironment in esophageal squamous cell carcinoma.
snippet: Esophageal squamous cell carcinoma (ESCC) features a poor prognosis and unclear pathogenesis, and the role of R-loops, key regulators of genome stability, has not been systematically characterized in this disease.
